description: Local visual exploration tool for transformer model internals using FastAPI + TransformerLens backend and SvelteKit + D3.js frontend

stories.title: Backend scaffold
acceptanceCriteria: backend/requirements.txt exists with fastapi, uvicorn, transformer-lens, torch, numpy
backend/main.py exists with FastAPI app, CORS for localhost:5173, lifespan model loading
GET /api/health returns {"status": "ok", "model_loaded": true} when model is loaded
GET /api/model-info returns {"model": "gpt2", "n_layers": 12, "n_heads": 12, "d_model": 768}
backend/analysis.py exists with extract_attention, compute_logit_lens, compute_logit_attribution functions

stories.title: Analysis endpoint
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/analyze returns tokens, token_ids, n_layers, n_heads, attention, logit_lens, top_predictions, logit_attribution
attention field shape is [n_layers][n_heads][seq][seq] and each row sums to 1.0 within 1e-5 tolerance
logit_lens has exactly 12 entries keyed layer_0 through layer_11, each a list of [token, probability] pairs
top_predictions is a list of [token, probability] pairs from the final layer
logit_attribution is a list of floats, one per input token, summing to 1.0
POST /api/analyze with empty text returns HTTP 400
POST /api/analyze with text tokenizing to >50 tokens returns HTTP 400 with message 'Input too long: N tokens. Limit is 50.'
backend/tests/test_analysis.py exists with tokenization test, attention shape test, row-sum test, logit_lens length test

stories.title: Frontend scaffold
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/package.json exists with sveltekit, typescript, d3, @types/d3 dependencies
frontend/svelte.config.js and frontend/vite.config.ts exist
frontend/src/app.html and frontend/src/app.css exist
frontend/src/routes/+page.svelte exists as main page
frontend/src/lib/api.ts exports analyzeText(text: string): Promise<AnalysisResult> with AnalysisResult type
frontend/src/lib/AttentionHeatmap.svelte, LogitLens.svelte, TokenChips.svelte exist
npm run build completes without TypeScript errors

stories.title: Attention heatmap
acceptanceCriteria: AttentionHeatmap.svelte uses D3.js to render an SVG heatmap with rows=source tokens, cols=destination tokens
Color scale goes from white (#ffffff) at 0.0 to deep blue (#1e40af) at 1.0
Token labels appear on both axes
Hover tooltip shows 'Token A → Token B: 0.342' format
Layer (0-11) and head (0-11) dropdowns exist in the panel and update the heatmap reactively
Selected token prop highlights the corresponding row in amber (#f59e0b)

stories.title: Logit lens table
acceptanceCriteria: LogitLens.svelte renders a table with exactly 12 rows after analysis (one per layer)
Table columns are: Layer, #1 prediction (token+%), #2 prediction, #3 prediction
Probabilities shown as percentages (e.g., '82%') sorted descending per row
Cell background opacity scales with probability value (higher prob = more opaque/saturated)
Layer 11 row has a distinct background color marking it as 'Final prediction'
Below table shows top_predictions as 'Top predictions: Paris 82%, France 5%, London 3%'

stories.title: Token interaction
acceptanceCriteria: TokenChips.svelte renders each token as a colored pill
Clicking a token selects it and updates selectedToken state in parent
AttentionHeatmap receives selectedToken and highlights that row in amber
Highlight persists when layer or head dropdown changes

stories.title: Logit attribution bar chart
acceptanceCriteria: A bar chart component renders below the logit lens with title 'Token contribution to top prediction'
One horizontal bar per input token, bar width proportional to attribution score
Token labels appear above each bar
Bar widths correctly reflect the logit_attribution values from the API response

stories.title: End-to-end flow
acceptanceCriteria: Loading spinner with 'Analyzing... (~2-5s on CPU)' shows while request is in flight
Error message displays when API returns 400
Analyze button is disabled while loading
All panels (TokenChips, AttentionHeatmap, LogitLens, attribution bar) populate after successful analysis
Responsive layout: single column on mobile (<768px), two columns on desktop

stories.title: README
acceptanceCriteria: README.md exists at project root
Contains backend setup section: Python 3.10+ requirement, pip install -r requirements.txt, uvicorn command
Contains frontend setup section: npm install, npm run dev
Contains ASCII diagram or screenshot placeholder of UI layout
Notes first-run model download (~500MB) and expected CPU inference time
Brief explanation of what each panel shows (attention heatmap, logit lens, token attribution)
